apidocs.auth_body: Create a key under Settings → API. Send it as a Bearer token. Idempotency-Key on POST makes a repeated call get the same response for 24 hours. Limit: 60 calls per minute and key.
apidocs.badge: Public badge for listings, no key.
apidocs.errors_body: Errors are returned as { code, detail } with HTTP status 401, 403, 404, 409 (conflict, e.g. double encumbrance), 422 (validation) or 429 (too many calls). Accepting a transfer always needs a person with BankID: the response is 202 with signing_url.
apidocs.lead: REST and JSON. The same permissions as in the app: a key acts as its organisation and is limited by its scopes. Every change becomes an event in the register's hash chain.

op.GET_get_machine: Machine as your role sees it.

op.POST_create_webhook: Create a webhook; the secret is returned once.
op.POST_initiate_transfer: Start a transfer; the buyer signs in the app.
op.POST_raise_flag: Raise a flag (stolen needs a police report number).
op.POST_register_encumbrance: Register an encumbrance (financier). 409 ACTIVE_ENCUMBRANCE_EXISTS if another is active.

apidocs.title: MaskinID API
apidocs.webhooks_body: Every delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256. Check the signature and that the timestamp is fresh. We retry five times with increasing intervals; failed deliveries can be sent again from Settings.

public.footer_about: {{app}} is an independent register for heavy machinery: owners, encumbrances, history and theft protection.

public.value_marketplace: Verified badge via API and checks before listing.
public.value_owner: Free fleet overview, certificate of ownership, theft protection, document vault, hours and service, share link when selling.

securitypage.anchor_body: Every night a combined checksum (Merkle root) of the day's events is computed. It is published here and in a public GitHub repository. Anyone holding an old value can see if anything changed.
securitypage.data_eu: All data is stored in the EU.
securitypage.data_exit: If the company ceases, register data is handed over to a neutral party.
securitypage.data_pentest: Penetration tests are done before the first bank integration and yearly thereafter.
securitypage.data_pnr: Personal numbers are never stored in clear text.
securitypage.data_rls: Every table is protected by row-level security and all writes go through controlled functions.
securitypage.disclosure_body: Found a security issue? E-mail us. We reply within two working days and do not report good-faith researchers.
securitypage.history_body: Every change is an event in an append-only log. Every event carries a checksum built on the previous event.
securitypage.lead: How {{app}} protects the register, and how you can verify yourself that the history has not been changed.
securitypage.title: Security
